BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Meeting Scheduler//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-20240117T110000Z@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240112T090000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour team planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol
LOCATION:Conference Room A
ORGANIZER;CN=Alice:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:carol@example.com
STATUS:CONFIRMED
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
python3 -c "
import re,datetime
b=[]
for f in ['alice','bob','carol']:
    t=open(f+'_calendar.ics').read()
    for m in re.finditer(r'DTSTART:(\S+)\s+DTEND:(\S+)',t):
        b.append((f,m.group(1),m.group(2)))
s=datetime.datetime(2024,1,17,11);e=s+datetime.timedelta(hours=1)
for f,a,z in b:
    A=datetime.datetime.strptime(a,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ');Z=datetime.datetime.strptime(z,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    assert not (A<e and s<Z),(f,a,z)
print('no conflicts')
"; ls -l meeting_scheduled.ics; git -C /app status 2>/dev/null | head -3; python3 -c "import icalendar" 2>&1 | tail -1
